stem.text: A sample of metal is subjected to a force which increases to a maximum value and then decreases back to zero. A force–extension graph for the sample is shown.

stem.alt: Force–extension graph with axes labelled force and extension, origin 0. A curve starts as a straight line from the origin and bends over, with points X and Y marked on it.

stem.text: When the sample contracts, it follows the same force–extension curve as when it was being stretched.
What is the behaviour of the metal between X and Y?
